description:
Local memory and context for you and your AI agent: Markdown notes, documents and tasks on your disk, with an MCP server for GitHub Copilot, Claude Code, Codex and Cursor.

Tisty keeps what you know on your own machine: notes, documents and tasks, in plain
Markdown files you can read without it. Everything you do is written to an append-only
log, so nothing is lost by accident and a change can be walked back; erasing something
for good is the one step that cannot. No account, no
subscription, no telemetry, no server. Sync, if you want it, goes through a folder both
your machines already reach, and an assistant can come in through a door you open.
v1.50.1
Empty documents can be written on again, and hooks and skills are one switch each
- A document with nothing written, opened or made right after another empty one, can be written on, with the cursor waiting at its title.
- A document with the same words as the one before it opens ready to write, and always shows its own page.
- Under each connected agent there are two switches and nothing else: Tisty's skills, for the whole computer, and Tisty's hooks, all at once.
- Connecting an agent turns both on: one yes shows first what is written, with a tick to leave each one out.
- The skills' card closes once you turn them on.
- If you added the hooks before 1.50, turning them off and on brings the newest one.
- The window can be moved from the strip over your folders and over Brainsty, as over every other screen.
- The notice of a new version is shorter.
What's Changed
- fix(docs): an empty document opened after another empty one is written on, not left blocked by @rgdevment in #987
- fix(window): the window is dragged from the top of folders and Brainsty too by @rgdevment in #988
- fix(about): a new version's row no longer carries a note on where else it shows by @rgdevment in #989
- fix(agents): hooks and skills are one switch each under every agent, and stay on when you connect it by @rgdevment in #990
Full Changelog: v1.50.0...v1.50.1
